changes: Reject mismatched dtype/shape/length before payload allocation/read; validate empty typed slices too.
Add actual Rust layout comparison and loop proof; model early validation separately from faithful decoding assumptions and allocation outcomes.

wheel.runtime_dependencies: existing NumPy/PyTorch reused; no Rust or maturin on test PATH
checks: no local source paths in generated metadata

interleaved_valid_read_control.mode: Two persistent installed-wheel readers, same immutable 64 MiB record, serial ABBA batches; no cache eviction or system-wide load isolation.

development_runs.baseline: Three selected regression failures on the previous wheel; original observation: full load reports allocation ValueError under 16 MiB margin and empty mismatched slice succeeds.
development_runs.initial_model: An initial-state-only empty-bypass counterexample was rejected by the runner. Added an explicit API-entry transition so the negative has a concrete execution trace; final focused/full checks are separate.
development_runs.initial_rust: An intermediate scripted wrapper edit failed compilation and the first equality proof needed a sequence-extensionality assertion. Both corrected; original logs retained.

limitations: Layout equality is proved for actual Rust; JSON decoding, Python shape/product validation, call placement, complete I/O and compiled-code conformance are unproved.

Early rejection prevents payload work after a typed mismatch is identified; metadata I/O/parsing/allocation still occur. Allocation errors, aborts and syscall progress are not comprehensively verified.
Optional lower-level expected layout only binds fields. TensorRef checks its own shape/product; byte-range callers may omit expected. Matching layouts still require byte authentication.
Four-host campaign uses per-host private records and child readers on the same host, not one shared record being read remotely by peers. Actual payload sizes are 4 KiB, 4 MiB and 64 MiB.

The single-host interleaved control uses one shared immutable 64 MiB record and two persistent wheel readers with serial ABBA batches, after full proof/integration jobs terminate. No cache eviction or system-wide isolation.

rchar deltas include metadata and /proc instrumentation; they are not physical backend I/O or exactly authenticated-byte counts. RSS values are high-water observations and do not prove an allocation bound.
Initial campaign overlaps formal/integration work. Baseline and fixed private fixtures differ. Quantiles mix hosts/positions and are observations, not a latency SLA or fairness premise.

No new 100 GB/TB physical measurement this round; earlier 100 GB records retain their own exact binaries and evidence. Normal GC deletes all campaign/control data before removing private metadata directories.
Passing tests and model checks does not establish that straw is bug-free or close complete recovery/refinement gaps.

publication_redaction.scope: Public summary with deployment identifiers and private artifact locations removed.
publication_redaction.provenance: Embedded source/tool hashes describe the original execution inputs. This redacted JSON is not byte-identical to the original private record and is not a replacement for raw proof logs.
